title: Loneliness In Gurbani
subtitle: Raag Gauree · Ang 256
summary: Loneliness is carried here from  toward o Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are.
whyItMatters: This shabad is useful when life feels alone, unseen, disconnected, because it keeps loneliness inside remembrance, conduct, and the Creator's larger care instead of private mood.
takeaway: Loneliness steadies when o Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਹਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਨ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਬੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: ddaahan laage dharam rai kineh na ghaalio ba(n)dh ||
lines.translation: When the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place any obstacle in His Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਨਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ubare jap haree saadhasa(n)g sanaba(n)dh ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||

structure: The opening movement names the pressure directly: .
The middle movement deepens the correction by holding the mind inside when the Righteous Judge of Dharma begins to destroy someone, no one can place.
The closing movement leaves a return you can actually keep: o Nanak, those who join the Saadh Sangat and meditate on the Lord are.
